title: Codex tighten project platform docs
summary: Use Codex to tighten the project manifest and project catalog documentation, keep changes small, and run targeted tests.

actions.prompt: Tighten the project manifest and project catalog documentation for clarity and consistency. Keep edits small and repo-local. Do not touch bootstrap/compose/edge/* or .codex/config.toml. After editing, run targeted validation/tests that cover the manifest/catalog path and leave the repo in a consistent state.
